items.name: INVENTUM Pato Branco 2026

venue.name: Sociedade Rural de Pato Branco
venue.address: R. Benjamin Borges dos Santos, 1121 - Fraron, Pato Branco - PR, 85503-350

items.information:
# Português 🇧🇷
Sejam bem-vindos ao primeiro campeonato de cubo mágico em Pato Branco! O campeonato será realizado junto à [INVENTUM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gNfuS6Ptm-M), a maior feira de técnologia do Paraná!

Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/INVENTUMPatoBranco2026/register).
Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, [leia o regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU).
Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

# English 🇺🇸
Your registrarion will only be apporved on the WCA website after the payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/INVENTUMPatoBranco2026/register) tab.
If this is your first time competing, [read the WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by [watching this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-81VRLyYhbQ).
There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: UACh al Cubo - Valdivia 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyMjE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--80d5da5d9e329fb7af6783cfd150fb44a3f45a05/image.png)

---


**UACh al Cubo 2026 esta aquí**

La primera competencia de Speedcubing llega a la ciudad de Valdivia. No te pierdas esta jornada llena de rompecabezas. 

Esta competencia está organizada en colaboración con la [Facultad de Ciencias de la Ingeniería de la Universidad Austral de Chile](https://www.instagram.com/fciuach/).

Por favor leer **ATENTAMENTE** las pestañas[ Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80093-preguntas-frecuentes), [Rondas Duales / Dobles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80098-rondas-duales-dobles) y [Competidores Nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80094-competidores-nuevos).

---

**UACh al Cubo 2026 is here**

The first speedcubing competition is coming to the city of Valdivia. Don't miss this event packed with puzzles. 

This competition is organized in collaboration with the [Faculty of Engineering Sciences at the Universidad Austral de Chile](https://www.instagram.com/fciuach/).

Please read the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80093-preguntas-frecuentes), [Dual/Double Rounds](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80098-rondas-duales-dobles), and [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80094-competidores-nuevos) tabs **CAREFULLY**.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VegasSpeedcubin2026#78256-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com)
